faq.q: ¿Puedo saber si tengo chinches solo por las picaduras?
faq.a: No. Las picaduras por sí solas no permiten confirmar que haya chinches; hay que buscar otros indicios, como las manchas oscuras en las costuras del colchón o ejemplares vivos.

blocks.html: The inspection focuses on mattress seams, the bed frame, the headboard and the area around the bed, plus other places where bed bugs may hide. What is found determines the extent of the problem and the recommended method.

faq.q: Can I tell if I have bed bugs from bites alone?
faq.a: No. Bites alone cannot confirm that you have bed bugs; you need to look for other signs, such as dark spots on the mattress seams or live insects.
